author: SGMC
body:
Hey guys, so I've been working on a walls map called Elemental recently, and have finished almost everything. It's a pretty simple map, with the 4 teams Grass (lime), Fire (red), Ice (white), and Darkness (gray). Here are a few screenshots of the sides:




The maps are fairly small, but the caves have enough iron for 2 full sets of armor and a sword and pickaxe. There is also a few chests and food to go around. A couple things that make this map special are that each side has their own sword and potion. What I mean by that is that somewhere in a chest in each side, there is a potion with either positive or negative effects, but not just a renegeration potion.
Oh no. Here are the potions in each of the 4 sides:


I tried to make the potions powerful, but not too powerful. They tend to have a lasting effect that is undesirable. As I said, each team also has a sword like this:I think the teams having different maps could cause the game to be a bit more interesting and challenging, as the players would need to master the tricks of all four maps instead of just one. But that's not to say that one map is better than  another, I tried my best to make them as equal as possible. Now, here comes the issue. I have absolutely no idea how to make a YAML and I can't really seem to figure it out. Would anyone out there be kind enough to make me one in return for being put as a map creator? I don't want anything too complicated, the only unusual thing I would want would be for the Fire team to have infinite fire resistance, Grass to have haste 1, Ice to have infinite speed 1, and Darkness to have infinite night vision. Could someone please do that for me? :D

replies.author: SGMC
replies.body: Well, I agree with the wood issue, so there are wood piles in the fire map that are more than enough to supply 20 planks for everyone. There is also about 20 logs spread throughout the chests and in the mineshaft, there is a wooden rail going down which would be another 30 planks. It's definitely as much wood as there is in the classic walls map with almost no trees.  About it being too small, it was originally designed to be a 1v1v1v1 map, but I'm not sure if that's even possible.
